```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(here)
library(purrr)
library(lubridate)
library(janitor)
library(sf)
library(ggspatial)
library(patchwork)
library(DT)

# set fig dir
fig_dir <- here("tagging", "figs")

# suppress warnings in knit
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE)
```

# Import + format data

## Capture data

- Many corrections made in lat/lons and missing locations
- Excluding any entries without species identified

```{r}
# Antigua
capture_anu <- read_excel(here("tagging", "data_raw", "AnuBlue shark tagging data.xlsx"), sheet = "Capture data") %>% 
  clean_names() %>%
  filter(!is.na(date)) %>%
  mutate(time = format(time, "%H:%M"),
         across(
           c(latitude, longitude, tl, fl, pcl),
           ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.)))) %>%
  select(date, time, location = island, site = location, lat = latitude, lon = longitude, sex, species, length_tl = tl, length_fl = fl, length_pcl = pcl, id_floy = floy, id_pit = pit_id, id_ptt = sat_ptt) %>%
  mutate()

# Saba/SXM
capture_saba <- read_excel(here("tagging", "data_raw", "YAG shark tagging data.xlsx"), sheet = "Capture data") %>% 
  clean_names() %>%
  # fixing lat/lon formatting mess
  mutate(latitude = ifelse(
    grepl("^\\d+\\.\\d+\\.\\d+$", latitude),
    sapply(strsplit(latitude, "\\."), \(x) as.numeric(x[1]) + as.numeric(x[2]) / 60 + as.numeric(x[3]) / 60000),
    suppressWarnings(as.numeric(latitude))),
    longitude = ifelse(
      grepl("^\\d+\\.\\d+\\.\\d+$", longitude),
      sapply(strsplit(longitude, "\\."), \(x) -(as.numeric(x[1]) + as.numeric(x[2]) / 60 + as.numeric(x[3]) / 60000)),
      -abs(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(longitude)))
    )) %>%
  # fixing swapped lat/lons
  mutate(temp = latitude,
         latitude = ifelse(latitude > 19, abs(longitude), latitude),
         longitude = ifelse(temp > 19, -abs(temp), longitude)) %>%
  select(-temp) %>%
  # collapsing date and formatting time and numerics
  mutate(year = as.integer(as.numeric(year)),
         day = as.integer(as.numeric(day)),
         date = lubridate::dmy(paste(day, month, year)),
         time = format(hms::as_hms(as.numeric(time)), "%H:%M"),
         across(
           c(tl_cm, fl_cm, pcl_cm),
           ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.)))) %>%
  select(date, time, location, site, lat = latitude, lon = longitude, sex, species = species_sn, length_tl = tl_cm, length_fl = fl_cm, length_pcl = pcl_cm, id_floy = floy, id_pit = pit, id_ptt = satellite_pitt)

# Merge
capture <- bind_rows(capture_anu, capture_saba) %>%
  filter(!is.na(species)) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ na_if(., "NA"))) %>%
  mutate(id_ptt = sub("\\.0$", "", id_ptt)) # fixing .0s after some PTTs
```

## Effort data

- Calculating proxy for fishing effort (hours fished x n buoys/hooks)
- Still need to correct site vs. location from YAG dataset

```{r}
## in raw data format times as number/time -> number/plain text

# Antigua
effort_anu <- read_excel(here("tagging", "data_raw", "AnuBlue shark tagging data.xlsx"), sheet = "Effort") %>% 
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(across(c(start_time, end_time, set_duration),
                hms::as_hms)) %>%
  tidyr::uncount(n_rigs) %>%
  select(date, location = island, set_duration)

# Saba
effort_saba <- read_excel(here("tagging", "data_raw", "YAG shark tagging data.xlsx"), sheet = "Sets") %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  filter(!time_haul_cor %in% c("?", "-")) %>%
  mutate(date = lubridate::dmy(paste(date, month, year)),
         across(
           c(time_in_cor, time_haul_cor),
           hms::as_hms
         )) %>%
  mutate(set_duration = hms::as_hms(time_haul_cor - time_in_cor)) %>%
  filter(set_duration > 0) %>%
  select(date, location, set_duration)

# Merge
effort <- bind_rows(effort_anu, effort_saba) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(),
      ~ na_if(as.character(.), "NA")))
```

## Movement data

- Missing demographic data for all Saba/SXM sat tagged sharks here
- Omitting 23U2179 due to discrepancies with capture data
```{r}
# Sat tag pings from Antigua Argos + Swimway data (output from shark_maps.Rmd)
pings <- suppressMessages(read_csv(here("tagging", "data_outputs", "pings_2025.csv"))) %>%

```

# Demographics

## Sample description
```{r}
sample <- capture %>%
  group_by(species, location) %>%
  summarize(n = n(),
            years_sampled = n_distinct(lubridate::year(date)),
            .groups = "drop")
datatable(sample, rownames = FALSE)

years <- capture %>%
  mutate(year = factor(year(date))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(length_tl), !is.na(year)) %>%
  group_by(species, location) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    years = n_distinct(year),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## Sex ratios

- Excluding Barbuda and St. Eustatius from statistical tests due to small sample sizes
- No significant differences in sex ratios by location except in *G. cirratum*, with only males caught in SXM
```{r}
sex_summary <- capture %>% 
  filter(sex %in% c("M", "F")) %>%
  count(species, location, sex) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = sex,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(ratio = round(M / F, 2))
datatable(sex_summary, rownames = FALSE)

ggplot(data = sex_summary %>%
         pivot_longer(
           cols = c(F, M),
           names_to = "sex",
           values_to = "n"
         ),
       aes(x = location, y = n, fill = sex)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~ species, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = "Location",
    y = "Number of sharks",
    fill = "Sex"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("F" = "#D95F6D", "M" = "#3686A0")
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "italic"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

sex_location_fishers <- capture %>% 
  filter(sex %in% c("M", "F") & !location %in% c("Barbuda", "St. Eustatius")) %>% # sample size is too small
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(
    p_value = round(fisher.test(table(location, sex))$p.value, 4),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
datatable(sex_location_fishers, rownames = FALSE)
```

## Total length

- Excluding Barbuda and St. Eustatius from statistical tests due to small sample sizes
```{r}
length_tl_summary <- capture %>%
  group_by(species, location) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(length_tl)),
    mean = round(mean(length_tl, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    sd = round(sd(length_tl, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    median = median(length_tl, na.rm = TRUE),
    min = min(length_tl, na.rm = TRUE),
    max = max(length_tl, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
datatable(length_tl_summary, rownames = FALSE)

ggplot(
  capture %>% filter(!is.na(length_tl), !is.na(location)),
  aes(x = location, y = length_tl)
) +
  # geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_violin() +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0, alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ species) + # scales = "free_x"
  labs(
    x = "Location",
    y = "Total length (cm)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
```


# Mapping

## Captures

### Prep

```{r}
sharks_sf <- capture %>%
    mutate(
    length_tl = as.numeric(length_tl)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(lon),
    !is.na(lat),
    !is.na(length_tl),
    !is.na(species)
  ) %>%
  st_as_sf(
    coords = c("lon", "lat"),
    crs = 4326
  )

esri_ocean <- paste0(
  "https://services.arcgisonline.com/arcgis/rest/services/",
  "Ocean/World_Ocean_Base/MapServer/tile/${z}/${y}/${x}.jpeg"
)
esri_world_imagery <- "https://services.arcgisonline.com/arcgis/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/${z}/${y}/${x}.jpeg"
```

### By species
```{r}
# map by species
ggplot() +
  annotation_map_tile(type = esri_ocean,
                      progress = "none",
                      zoomin = 0) +
  geom_sf(data = sharks_sf,
          aes(color = species),
          alpha = 0.7,
          size = .7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("goldenrod1", "magenta3", "limegreen", "coral")) +
  labs(color = "Species",
       x = NULL,
       y = NULL) +

```

### By size

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=15, out.width="100%"}
# Transform all shark locations to EPSG:3857
sharks_proj <- st_transform(sharks_sf, 3857)

# Shared bounding box across all species
bb <- st_bbox(sharks_proj)
buffer_prop <- 0.1

xlim <- bb[c("xmin", "xmax")] +
  diff(bb[c("xmin", "xmax")]) * buffer_prop * c(-1, 1)
ylim <- bb[c("ymin", "ymax")] +
  diff(bb[c("ymin", "ymax")]) * buffer_prop * c(-1, 1)

# plot
p_shark_size <- function(sp) {
  ggplot() +
    annotation_map_tile(
      type = esri_ocean,
      progress = "none",
      zoomin = 0
    ) +
    geom_sf(
      data = filter(sharks_proj, species == sp),
      aes(color = length_tl),
      alpha = 0.8, size = 1
    ) +
    coord_sf(
      crs = st_crs(3857),
      xlim = xlim,
      ylim = ylim,
      expand = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_color_gradientn(
      colours = c("yellow", "orange", "magenta")
    ) +
    labs(
      title = sp,
      color = "Total length (cm)",
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.key = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "italic")
    )
}

# Plot every species with the same map extent and individual scales
species_list <- unique(na.omit(capture$species))

plots <- setNames(
  lapply(species_list, p_shark_size),
  species_list
)

wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 1)

ggsave(here(fig_dir, "map_size.png"), width = 6, height = 12)
```

## Tracking

### Prep

```{r}
# link ESRI layers
esri_ocean <- paste0('https://services.arcgisonline.com/arcgis/rest/services/','Ocean/World_Ocean_Base/MapServer/tile/${z}/${y}/${x}.jpeg')
esri_world_imagery <- "https://services.arcgisonline.com/arcgis/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/${z}/${y}/${x}.jpeg"

# function to prep data and bounding boxes based on dif data subsets
prepare_shark_df <- function(pings, pttids = NULL, buffer_prop = 0.5, crs_out = 3857) {
  
  # filter PTTIDs if provided
  data_sub <- if (!is.null(pttids)) {
    pings %>% filter(id_ptt %in% pttids)
  } else {
    pings
  }
  
  # convert to numeric
  data_sub$lon <- as.numeric(data_sub$lon)
  data_sub$lat <- as.numeric(data_sub$lat)
  
  # convert to sf and project
  sf_proj <- st_as_sf(data_sub, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326) %>%
    st_transform(crs_out)
  
  # extract x, y
  df_proj <- sf_proj %>%
    mutate(
      x = st_coordinates(.)[,1],
      y = st_coordinates(.)[,2]
    ) %>%
    st_set_geometry(NULL)
  
  # calculate buffered bbox from subset
  expand_range <- function(x, buffer = 0.05) {
    r <- range(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    r + diff(r) * buffer * c(-1, 1)
  }
  
  lon_lim <- expand_range(data_sub$lon, buffer_prop)
  lat_lim <- expand_range(data_sub$lat, buffer_prop)
  
  bb_buffered <- st_as_sfc(st_bbox(c(
    xmin = lon_lim[1], xmax = lon_lim[2],
    ymin = lat_lim[1], ymax = lat_lim[2]
  ), crs = 4326))
  
  bb_3857 <- st_bbox(st_transform(bb_buffered, crs_out))
  xlim_3857 <- bb_3857[c("xmin", "xmax")]
  ylim_3857 <- bb_3857[c("ymin", "ymax")]
  
  list(
    df_proj = df_proj,
    xlim = xlim_3857,
    ylim = ylim_3857
  )
}

# color palette for tracks (add more if needed, or combine with linetypes?)
shark_palette <- c(
  "coral1",
  "goldenrod1",
  "seagreen1",
  "turquoise2",
  "magenta",
  "azure1",
  "orange",
  "aquamarine",
  "darkolivegreen1",
  "hotpink",
  "slategray1",
  "orangered"
)

# function for plotting shark tracks
p_shark <- function(pings,
                    pttids_subset = NULL,
                    species_filter = NULL,
                    buffer_prop = 0.5,
                    target_ratio = NULL,
                    start_date = NULL,
                    show_legend = TRUE,
                    animate = FALSE) {
  
  # ---- filter data ----
  data_sub <- pings
  
  if(!is.null(species_filter)) {
    data_sub <- data_sub %>% filter(species == species_filter)
  }
  
  if(!is.null(pttids_subset)) {
    data_sub <- data_sub %>% filter(id_ptt %in% pttids_subset)
  }
  
  if(!is.null(start_date)) {
    data_sub <- data_sub %>% filter(date >= as.Date(start_date))
  }
  
  # ---- projection + bbox ----
  prep <- prepare_shark_df(data_sub, buffer_prop = buffer_prop)
  df_proj <- prep$df_proj
  
  # ---- adjust bbox for target ratio if requested ----
  xlim_adj <- prep$xlim
  ylim_adj <- prep$ylim
  
  if(!is.null(target_ratio)){
    x_rng <- diff(prep$xlim)
    y_rng <- diff(prep$ylim)
    
    if((x_rng / y_rng) < target_ratio){
      # make x wider
      x_mid <- mean(prep$xlim)
      x_half <- (target_ratio * y_rng) / 2
      xlim_adj <- x_mid + c(-x_half, x_half)
    } else {
      # make y taller
      y_mid <- mean(prep$ylim)
      y_half <- x_rng / target_ratio / 2
      ylim_adj <- y_mid + c(-y_half, y_half)
    }
  }
  
  # ---- base map ----
  p <- ggplot() +
    annotation_map_tile(type = esri_world_imagery,
                        progress = "none",
                        zoomin = 0) +
    coord_sf(crs = st_crs(3857),
             xlim = xlim_adj,   # USE adjusted limits
             ylim = ylim_adj,   # USE adjusted limits
             expand = FALSE) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 18) +
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "steelblue"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = ifelse(animate, "none", "right"),
      legend.key = element_blank()
    ) +
    geom_path(
      data = df_proj,
      aes(x = x, y = y, group = id_ptt, color = id_ptt),
      linewidth = 1,
      alpha = 0.7,
      linetype = "11"
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = df_proj,
      aes(x = x, y = y, group = id_ptt, color = id_ptt, shape = category),
      size = ifelse(animate, 2, 1),
      alpha = 0.7
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      name = "Type",
      values = c(
        "Deployment" = 8,
        "Ping" = 16)
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)
  
  # ---- automatic palette ----
  pttid_levels <- sort(unique(df_proj$id_ptt))
  colors <- shark_palette[seq_along(pttid_levels)] # Trim palette to needed length
  colors <- setNames(colors, pttid_levels) # Name colors so they match PTTIDs
  p <- p + scale_color_manual(values = colors,
                              name = "PTT ID")
  
  # safety check
  if(length(pttid_levels) > length(shark_palette)) {
    stop("Not enough colors in shark_palette! Add more to shark_palette vector.")
  }
  
  # ---- turn animation ON if requested ----
  if(animate) {
    p <- p +
      labs(title = 'Shark movement: {format(frame_along, "%B %d, %Y")}') +
      transition_reveal(along = date) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(
          hjust = 0,
          size = 26,
          face = "bold"
        )
      )
  }
  
  # ---- turn legend ON/OFF if requested ----
  if (!show_legend) {
    p <- p + theme(legend.position = "none")
  }
  
  return(p)
}
```

### By species

```{r}

                           species_filter  = "Galeocerdo cuvier",
                           target_ratio = 1,
                            buffer_prop = .2) +
```
